description: Keccak-256 hash (the Ethereum hash) of text or of 0x hex bytes, as used for function selectors, event topics and storage slots. Use when building or decoding EVM calls. Costs $0.001 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

text.description: Text, or 0x-prefixed hex bytes, up to 10,000 characters
